shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null

grep -rE "export (declare )?(function|const) (after|revalidateTag|unstable_cache)" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "---next/server---"; grep -rE "after" /workspace/node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---next/cache---"; grep -rE "unstable_cache|revalidateTag" /workspace/node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/node_modules/next/package.json').version)"

find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server -name "after*" -o -path "*after*" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "---index.d.ts---"; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after/*.d.ts

grep -rn "revalidateTag" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "---search---"; grep -rln "export declare function revalidateTag\|function revalidateTag" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist 2>/dev/null | head

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts; echo "===CacheLife==="; find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "CacheLifeConfig\|cacheLife" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "===profiles==="; grep -rn "type CacheLifeProfile\|CacheLifeProfile =" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist 2>/dev/null | head
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js 2>/dev/null
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.js 2>/dev/null; echo "===awaiter==="; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after/awaiter.js 2>/dev/null
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after-context.js 2>/dev/null
grep -n "profile\|revalidateTag\|expire\|cacheLife\|pendingRevalidatedTags\|revalidateTag(" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/revalidation-utils.js 2>/dev/null | head -60
grep -rn "cacheLife\s*:\|'max'\|\"max\"\|weeks:\|days:\|defaultCacheLife\|cacheLifeProfiles" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js 2>/dev/null | head -40
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "=== tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -45; echo "=== build exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="

cd /workspace && (PORT=3001 npx next start -p 3001 >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4 ; echo "=== / (should redirect to /catalog) ===" ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3001/ ; echo "=== /catalog ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3001/catalog | grep -oE "Sync latest catalog|Starting sync…|Product Catalog|<form action=\"[^\"]*\"|<th[^>]*>[A-Za-z]+</th>|Laptop|Phone" | sort -u

curl -s http://localhost:3001/catalog | grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+|\$ACTION_REF_[0-9]+|"id":"[a-f0-9]{32,}"|actionId|self\.__next_f\.push' | head -20; echo "=== raw search for action hashes ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3001/catalog | grep -oE '[a-f0-9]{40}' | sort -u | head

curl -s http://localhost:3001/catalog -o /tmp/catalog.html; echo "=== ACTION_ID line ==="; grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' /tmp/catalog.html; echo "=== ACTION_REF / ACTION_1 ==="; grep -oE '\$ACTION_REF_[0-9]+|\$ACTION_1:[0-9]+' /tmp/catalog.html | sort -u; echo "=== prices on first load ==="; grep -oE '\$[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}' /tmp/catalog.html | sort -u

AID="00768495061048e6bb78b594e81b48f4b241ca0080"
echo "=== invoking server action (should return fast, sync runs in background) ==="
time curl -s -o /tmp/action-resp.txt -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" \
  -X POST "http://localhost:3001/catalog" \
  -H "Next-Action: $AID" \
  -H "Accept: text/x-component" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" \
  --data-raw '[]'
echo "=== response head ==="; head -c 300 /tmp/action-resp.txt; echo
echo "=== prices IMMEDIATELY after action (expect stale: 199/299/499/699/999) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3001/catalog | grep -oE '\$[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}' | sort -u

echo "waiting 4.5s for background sync + revalidateTag..."; sleep 4.5
echo "=== prices AFTER background sync (expect CHANGED values) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3001/catalog | grep -oE '\$[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}' | sort -u
echo "=== server log (look for after()/revalidate errors) ==="
grep -iE "after|revalidate|error|warn|E[0-9]{3}" /tmp/next-start.log | grep -viE "telemetry|compiled|generat|collect|optim|route|prerender|static|dynamic|○|ƒ|┌|├|└" | head -20
echo "=== tail of server log ==="; tail -5 /tmp/next-start.log

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
cd /workspace && npm run build >/tmp/build2.log 2>&1; echo "build exit: $?"
tail -8 /tmp/build2.log
cat /tmp/build2.log | tail -15; echo "=== build exit code check ==="; grep -c "Compiled successfully\|Failed to compile" /tmp/build2.log
npm run build > /tmp/build2.log 2>&1; echo "build exit: $?"; tail -12 /tmp/build2.log

cd /workspace && (PORT=3002 npx next start -p 3002 >/tmp/next-start2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
AID="00768495061048e6bb78b594e81b48f4b241ca0080"
echo "=== initial prices ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3002/catalog | grep -oE '\$[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo
echo "=== invoke action ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3002/catalog" -H "Next-Action: $AID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data-raw '[]'
echo "=== wait 5s ==="; sleep 5
echo "=== prices after 5s ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3002/catalog | grep -oE '\$[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo
echo "=== TRACE LOG ==="; grep -E "\[sync\]|\[action\]" /tmp/next-start2.log

curl -s http://localhost:3002/catalog -o /tmp/cat2.html
AID=$(grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' /tmp/cat2.html | head -1 | sed 's/\$ACTION_ID_//')
echo "new AID=$AID"
echo "=== prices before action ==="; grep -oE '\$[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}' /tmp/cat2.html | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo
echo "=== invoke action ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3002/catalog" -H "Next-Action: $AID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data-raw '[]'
for t in 0 2 4 6 8; do
  sleep $(( t==0 ? 0 : 2 ))
  P=$(curl -s http://localhost:3002/catalog | grep -oE '\$[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
  echo "t=${t}s prices: $P"
done
echo "=== TRACE LOG ==="; grep -E "\[sync\]|\[action\]" /tmp/next-start2.log

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
cd /workspace && rm -rf .next && npm run build > /tmp/build3.log 2>&1; echo "build exit: $?"; tail -6 /tmp/build3.log
cat /tmp/build3.log | tail -10
rm -rf .next && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12

(npx next start -p 3003 >/tmp/srv3.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
curl -s http://localhost:3003/catalog -o /tmp/c3.html
AID=$(grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' /tmp/c3.html | head -1 | sed 's/\$ACTION_ID_//')
echo "AID=$AID"
echo "=== BEFORE (original prices expected) ==="; grep -oE '\$[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}' /tmp/c3.html | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo
echo "=== invoke action (non-blocking expected) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3003/catalog" -H "Next-Action: $AID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data-raw '[]'
for t in 1 3 5 7; do
  sleep 2
  P=$(curl -s http://localhost:3003/catalog | grep -oE '\$[0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
  echo "t=${t}s prices: $P"
done
echo "=== redirect check: / -> ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3003/
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; cd /workspace && git status --short && echo "--- files ---" && git status --short | wc -l
git status --short
git diff package.json tsconfig.json

cd /workspace; echo "=== stray next procs ==="; pgrep -af "next start|next-server" || echo "none"; echo "=== comments/logs in my files ==="; grep -nE "console\.|^\s*//" app/catalog/page.tsx app/catalog/sync-button.tsx lib/catalog.ts lib/db.js app/page.tsx || echo "none"
